english.note: Use this when emphasizing formal oversight or directing the work of a group or organization.

exampleSentences.english: The manager will supervise the whole project to make sure everything goes according to plan.
exampleSentences.traditional: 經理會監督成個工程，確保一切按計劃進行。

english.note: Use this for official or formal supervision, especially checking that work or spending is properly carried out.

exampleSentences.english: The audit committee has a duty to oversee the use of the construction funds.
